match.layers: The structural verdict reads the dealing terms on record (cells 3.1, 3.3, 2.7, plan-independent). The scenario verdict is ILLUSTRATIVE (the plan's filed outflow proxy as the base demand and the turnover assumptions as the stress, against the same capacity, per plan).
match.plan_display_label: Global management-consulting firm profit-sharing/401(k) plan (~$9.8B, NY)
reasons: STRUCTURAL GAP (narrowed): this plan is PARTIALLY participant-directed per its own Form 5500 codes (2H, no 2G/404(c) code filed). A trustee-directed sleeve could hold this wrapper directly (cell 3.5), and the daily-menu constraint applies only to the participant-directed portion, where the menu assumes daily liquidity whereas repurchases are suspended (cell 3.1).
Repurchase program suspended (cell 3.1): ordinary repurchase requests are not accepted, so participant liquidity depends on the program reopening. Capacity is 0%. Gating precedent on top (3.3).
Early repurchase economics: 5% if held < 1 year (2.7). Relevant to participant-level churn (2.7).
Capacity: repurchases are suspended (cell 3.1): ordinary requests are not accepted. Capacity is 0% until the program reopens.

Filed outflow proxy (Schedule H, plan year 2024-01-01 to 2024-12-31): 6.5% of the position per year vs 0% annual wrapper capacity, the plan's total expenses less administrative expenses over beginning net assets, applied to the position. EXCEEDS: repurchases are closed, so every request waits for the program to reopen.

Slider assumption (illustrative): 13.7% of the position per year vs 0% annual wrapper capacity, from tail turnover 20%/yr on the 58.2% of accounts that are separated and active turnover 5%/yr on the rest. Shown beside the filed rate, not blended with it. EXCEEDS: repurchases are closed, so every request waits for the program to reopen.

Scenario verdict (ILLUSTRATIVE, this plan): misaligned. Base rung: the filed outflow proxy 6.5% of the position per year exceeds the annual wrapper capacity 0% (repurchases suspended (3.1), prorated under stress before (3.3)). Proration assumption: an oversubscribed offer is filled pro rata and the unfilled remainder waits for the next window.

Schedule H benefit-payment line 2e is not yet in the plan record. The filed outflow proxy (total expenses less administrative expenses over beginning net assets) stands in for it as the base demand, and the turnover assumptions are the stress around it.
